market_summary: Across the board, markets are in a low-volatility consolidation phase during the second half of the New York session following aggressive earlier trend moves. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), and BTCUSD are hovering in tight ranges below their respective session VWAPs, EMA50s, and Value Area Lows with sub-1.0 RVOL, lacking volume confirmation for further downside continuation. Meanwhile, US100 trades constructively above VWAP but is capped directly beneath Call Wall #1 in a positive gamma dampening regime, ruling out long entries and demanding strict capital preservation across all six assets.

signals.rationale: Value Profile shows price at 3880.68 trading below VAL (3893.78) and well below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH at -7.38 with a mild positive slope (+0.9) reflecting light intraday short-covering. In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price remains structurally bearish below both VWAP (3933.36) and EMA50 (3914.54). Candles are consolidating mid-channel between the EMA20 baseline (3885.58) and lower ATR band (3865.07). RVOL is low at 0.788 without yellow bar confirmation. Price holds above Session Low (3852.35) and below S/R (3924.30). GEX indicates a POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime with price above Gamma Flip (3871.62), well under Call Wall #1 (4148.94) and above Put Wall #1 (3821.39), favoring chop/mean-reversion rather than continuation.

Price at 1.10534 is situated below VAL (1.10708) and below POC (1.10942). Cumulative Delta is NEUTRAL at -4,595 with a negative slope (-266.26), showing absence of aggressive buying. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. The trend is firmly bearish beneath declining VWAP (1.10785) and EMA50 (1.10753). Volatility envelope shows price pinned against the lower ATR band (1.10484) and below EMA20 (1.10640). RVOL is muted at 0.776 without yellow volume spike validation. Candles are hovering right above Session Low (1.10457) and beneath S/R (1.10662) without forming an actionable sweep or continuation trigger.

Value Profile context shows price at 1.32329 below VAL (1.32438) and below POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH at -5,560 but exhibits positive delta slope divergence (+3157.58), indicating localized buying into session lows. Current session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (1.32552) and EMA50 (1.32530), confirming structural weakness. Price is consolidating in the lower ATR channel band (1.32229) beneath EMA20 (1.32409). RVOL is 1.538, lacking the required > 2.0 yellow volume confirmation for an expansion trade. The market is caught between Session Low support (1.32210) and S/R resistance (1.32500).

Price at 28397.3 is trading above VAH (28244.33) and above POC (28122.95). CVD is NEUTRAL (+2.05) with a flat slope (+0.13). Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains bullish above both rising VWAP (28177.99) and EMA50 (28230.63). Position in the ATR channel is mid-range between EMA20 (28310.86) and upper ATR (28513.69). RVOL is 0.873 (index CFD volume caveat applies, though yellow bars are absent). In GEX context, regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING, with price holding above Gamma Flip (28307.07) and Put Wall #1 (28300.46), but directly pressing into Call Wall #1 (28430.46, strength 0.89). Buying directly into Call Wall #1 is prohibited, and dealers hedge against unconfirmed breakouts, warranting a hold.

Value Profile shows price at 50.167 well below VAL (50.720) and below POC (51.460). CVD is BEARISH at -281 with a negative slope (-12.94), aligning with the broader session trend. During NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trending strongly downward below VWAP (51.022) and EMA50 (50.620). Candles are mid-channel, testing the EMA20 baseline (50.197) from below within the ATR bounds (49.783 - 50.610). RVOL is low at 0.769 with no yellow volume breakout spikes. Price is pulling back from Session Low (49.688) toward overhead S/R (50.711) without confirming a fresh rejection candle.

Price at 71838.6 trades below VAL (71917.91) and below POC (73501.60). CVD is BEARISH at -0.07 with flat delta slope (+0.01). Timing is NEW_YORK_SESSION. The asset is structurally bearish below downward-sloping VWAP (72781.64) and EMA50 (72489.92). Candles are consolidating mid-channel between EMA20 (71929.45) and lower ATR band (71228.37). RVOL sits at 0.779 without yellow bar interest. Price remains range-bound between Session Low (71141.0) and Prev Low resistance (73097.30), lacking directional catalyst or breakout confirmation.
